classifier_enabled.description: Use the Flash model for ambiguous intent and security classification.

flash_provider_id.description: AstrBot provider ID used by the front classifier.

classifier_timeout_seconds.description: Maximum time allowed for a Flash classification request.

command_min_confidence.description: Minimum Flash confidence required to route a natural command.

security_min_confidence.description: Minimum Flash confidence required to block ambiguous harassment or injection.

security_reply_timeout_seconds.description: Maximum time allowed for a Flash-generated security reply.

security_reply_temperature.description: Sampling temperature for varied Flash-generated security replies.

security_reply_max_tokens.description: Maximum output tokens for a Flash-generated security reply.

cache_ttl_seconds.description: Classification cache lifetime for repeated identical messages.

cache_max_entries.description: Maximum number of hashed classification cache entries.
